---
title: "COMSOL Modeling and Machine Learning"
subtitle: "Computational methods"
---

Finite-element simulations and event-level analysis support the interpretation of nanopore measurements.

## Research question

How can modeling and data analysis help compare devices and experimental conditions?

## Approach

COMSOL simulations examine electric-field distributions in heterogeneous nanopores. Signal analysis extracts event features for statistical comparisons and supervised learning.

## Research scope

Modeling provides a way to examine proposed physical explanations; statistical learning provides a way to assess differences in measured signals. Model performance depends on validation and the separation of training and evaluation data.
